source.title: Maximize the Profit as the Salesman

teaching.hint: If a chosen offer ends at a particular house, which earlier houses can still have been sold?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: An optimal plan over a house prefix either ignores offers ending there or takes exactly one and combines it with the best plan strictly before its start.
solution_outline.approach: Group offers by their end house. Sweep the house positions, carrying forward the prior optimum or taking any offer ending at that position plus the optimum before its start.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: After processing the first i houses, the state is the maximum profit using only houses before i.
solution_outline.correctness: An optimum for a prefix either sells no offer ending at its last house or contains one such offer; all other chosen offers must end before its start. Both exhaustive cases are evaluated and realizable.
solution_outline.complexity: O(n+m) time and O(n+m) auxiliary space for n houses and m offers.
solution_outline.pitfall: Intervals sharing an endpoint house overlap; combining an offer starting at s with a state that includes house s double-sells it.

common_wrong_turns: Choose the offer with most gold first
Allow two inclusive intervals to share a house
source_fidelity_notes: Inclusive endpoints, optional unsold houses, and all size bounds remain explicit.
